_readme: Our resources. Edit by hand or use tools/add_resource.py. Keys: 'general' (shown on the Resources page), 'units' (keyed by unit slug) and 'lessons' (keyed by 'unit-slug/lesson-slug'). Each entry takes title, url, kind (link|html|pdf|video|worksheet|sheet|notebook|book), optional note, and optional group ('links' for a reference we use, 'ours' for something we made or keep). group defaults to 'ours' for a local path under assets/resources/ and 'links' for an external URL.
